meta.note: US sweepstakes casino (dual currency: Gold Coins bought, Sweeps Coins redeemed for cash prizes): own platform + originals-led library, serves every US state where sweepstakes casinos remain lawful as of Nov 2026 (addressable population ≈ 213M of 340M), no gaming licence or gaming duty — the cost of compliance is counsel, state monitoring and geo-fencing. Setup Dec 2026, launch Jan 2027, funded by Liran's two tranches ($320K + $780K), a $2.5M seed in June 2027 and a $4M Series A in November 2027.
meta.scenarioLabel: Accelerated plan: $8M Series A (Nov 2027) — ×3 marketing step, expansion from M14, team a year earlier. Same pre-seed and seed as the plan.

funding.name: Pre-seed — Tranche 1 (Liran)
funding.note: Sets the company up and carries it through the January launch. Pays for the December setup (Cyprus structure, US entity and sweepstakes legal structure, first hires, content and platform agreements, tech setup, lab certification) and the first month live. About $285K is spent before Tranche 2 arrives.

funding.name: Pre-seed — Tranche 2 (Liran)
funding.note: Marketing and liquidity. Arrives February 2027: the prize reserve ($150K until the seed, about 1.4 months of May redemptions), marketing through May (about $165K) and the launch team. Carries the business to the end of May with about $30K of free cash — there is no slack, so the seed has to close on time.

funding.name: Seed — Prove
funding.note: Lands June 2027, raised on five months of live cohorts (CPA, purchase retention, payback by state group). Restores the prize reserve to $300K, starts the own-platform build ($500K over nine months) and the hires held back until now (engineers, affiliate and CRM leads, games manager, payment ops), and funds marketing up to the scale-up.

funding.name: Series A — Accelerate ($8M)
funding.note: Raised on the same cohorts as the plan’s Series A, but sized to buy the growth now: a ×3 marketing step at M12 instead of ×2, the expansion phase from M14 instead of M26 at 10% a month, and the scale-up team a year earlier. Sized to survive CPA +20% and retention −15% together.

personnel.note: Capital, legal structure, key vendor deals (platform, aggregator, payment processors), hiring the founding five. Owns cohort analytics and the smoking-gun dashboard until the analyst hire — the scale-up call is the CEO's number.

Own-platform architecture: dual-currency wallet (Gold Coins / Sweeps Coins), cashier, redemption engine, geo-fencing. Hire 3 engineers in 60 days. 90-day KPI: staging platform with cashier + 1 aggregator integrated.
Site UX, lobby, coin-store and promo engine spec, game roadmap incl. the in-house titles. 90-day KPI: product live in all open state groups.
Base $10.5K + up to $23K/mo performance bonus, paid on quarterly results. 90-day KPI: 20 affiliate/streamer contracts signed, first 500 first-time purchasers, CPA within 20% of model.

Card acquiring + ACH/open-banking + Apple/Google Pay live pre-launch; authorisation rate >85%; redemption payout rails (ACH, gift cards). Owns net margin after prizes, processor reserve terms, chargebacks.

Official sweepstakes rules, AMOE (free mail-in entry) operations, state exclusion matrix and geo-fencing, KYC at redemption, 1099 reporting, responsible-play policies. Monitors every state bill and AG action.

External US sweepstakes/gaming counsel on retainer — entity structuring, official rules, state-by-state opinions, processor and provider contracts, ad-compliance opinions. Not headcount; scales to ad-hoc billing in G&A.

Base $7.5K + up to $5K/mo bonus on purchase retention and NGR-per-payer targets. Promo-coin economics (hold promo SC cost ≤ target % of net revenue), lifecycle campaigns, CRM stack. 90-day KPI: D30 purchaser retention ≥ model M1.
Curates the portfolio and lobby merchandising, owns provider/aggregator relationships and the new-game integration pipeline, RTP variants per title. The commercial owner of the game floor.
Wallet, cashier, redemption engine, integrations, site, geo-fencing.
Crash + instant + own slots = the in-house margin play (no provider fee). Launch runs on external content; ship own title #1 by launch+5, #2 by launch+8.
Base $5.5K + up to $11K/mo bonus on payback-qualified first purchasers (not raw volume). Deal pipeline pre-launch, then program ops, streamer deals, deal compliance, affiliate fraud watch.
Base $5K + up to $4K/mo bonus on 90-day ROAS per state group. Meta (narrowed categories), TikTok, programmatic, push — Google search/display is closed to sweeps brands.
Base $5K + up to $3K/mo bonus on retention & reactivation uplift. Campaign ops per state group.
Base $4.5K + up to $13K/mo bonus on managed-book NGR & VIP retention. Top 5% of payers = 50–65% of purchases. Personal hosts from the first 1,000 purchasers.
Redemption review, processor reconciliation, chargeback representment, rail failover. Partially automated; scales with purchase volume.
Added from the marketing scale-up.
Salary-only by design. Scales with purchaser volume: promo-abuse rings, multi-accounting, payment fraud, state-exclusion evasion.

Site, promos, game art for in-house titles.
Takes over the cohort/LTV dashboard from the CEO. Cohort tracking vs this model; owns actual-vs-model on every base KPI from then on.
Manage the outsourced 24/7 agent pool (the $-per-active variable line). ~1 lead per 25–35 agents.
Multi-entity bookkeeping (Cyprus holding, US operating company), processor reconciliation, prize-reserve treasury, 1099 filings.
Joins at break-even: treasury at scale, audit, reporting to the Series A board, M&A readiness.
Owns the brand-at-scale budget: sponsorships, streamers, partnerships.
Runs operations across state groups as the business passes $100M NGR.

geos.name: Midwest & Plains
geos.note: OH, MO, WI, IA, KS, NE, SD, ND (34.0M). Open states; Ohio HB 298 sits in House Finance — watch item.

geos.name: West & Mountain
geos.note: CO, OR, NM, HI, AK (14.4M). Open states. Nevada, Washington and Idaho are excluded (statute / enforcement).

geos.name: Northeast + DC
geos.note: MA, NH, RI, VT + DC (10.9M). Open. DC bill B26-0656 cleared committee 18 Nov 2026 — DC may drop out. NY, NJ, CT, ME excluded.

geos.name: Grey states
geos.note: FL, PA, IL, AZ, MD, MN, UT, AR, WV, WY (77.9M). Lawful today but under AG suits, cease-and-desist letters or 2027 ban bills (Florida, Pennsylvania HB 2801, Wyoming draft). Budget capped at half the open-state rate; untick to model a full exit.
